sessions.note: FDAX most active during Europe open; ES/NQ/YM/RTY most active during US open

indicators.note: Multi-timeframe MA stack — intraday bias aligned with daily/weekly/monthly structure

bullish: Price is above SMA20H and EMA21 on the current intraday timeframe
EMA8 > EMA21 on the intraday timeframe (bull cross or bullish stack)
Price is above SMA20D on the daily chart
Daily EMA stack is bullish: EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA50
Price is above SMA50W (macro bull trend intact)
bearish: Price is below SMA20H and EMA21 on the current intraday timeframe
EMA8 < EMA21 on the intraday timeframe (bear cross or bearish stack)
Price is below SMA20D on the daily chart
Daily EMA stack is bearish: EMA8 < EMA21 < EMA50
Price is below SMA50W (macro bear trend)
neutral: Price is oscillating around SMA20H or EMA21 — no clear bias
EMA8 and EMA21 are flat or crossing repeatedly
Price is between SMA20D and EMA50D — compression zone
Conflicting signals across timeframes (e.g. bullish intraday, bearish daily)

risk_rules: Define max risk per trade before entry — stick to it
No revenge trading after a stop-out — wait for the next valid setup
No new entries in the last 30 minutes before market close
If daily drawdown exceeds 2x normal stop size, stop trading for the day
Always check correlation: ES/NQ/YM/RTY tend to move together — avoid stacking correlated longs or shorts
FDAX follows ES/NQ directionally but has its own open — treat separately
BTC positions should not influence futures bias and vice versa

instrument_notes.FDAX: DAX Futures (Eurex) — highest liquidity 08:00-17:30 CET. Tick size 0.5 points.
instrument_notes.ES: S&P 500 E-mini (CME) — most liquid US index future. Tick size 0.25 points.
instrument_notes.NQ: Nasdaq 100 E-mini (CME) — high beta, amplified moves vs ES. Tick size 0.25 points.
instrument_notes.YM: Dow E-mini (CBOT) — fewer components, can diverge from ES/NQ. Tick size 1 point.
instrument_notes.RTY: Russell 2000 E-mini (CME) — small caps, risk-on/off indicator. Tick size 0.1 points.
instrument_notes.BTC: Bitcoin — 24/7, treat Asia session separately from US session.
